Sub: Addition of columns in. the Claim Forms 19, Form 20, Form 10C, 
Form 5(IF). and Form 31 in Mode of Remittance - Inclusion of 
payments through Core Banking System. 
Consequent upon the issue of this office Memorandum No. 
WSU/4(2)91/Man/Amdt/20007 dated 20th October 2009 regarding addition 
of the Mode of Payment through Internet Banking under CBS it is felt that an 
Additional Option for sending the payment under Core Banking System is 
required to be inserted in column of Mode of Payments in the Claim Forms 
also viz., Form 19 & Form 20 for PF settlements, Form 10-C for Pension, Form 
5(IF) for EDLI and Form 31 for various Advances. Accordingly, the following 
Additional Column may be incorporated as Column (c) in all the above 
Claim Forms under the heading 'Mode of Remittance' as under: - 
[c] By Electronic Credit in my S.B. Account through Core Banking 
System 
2.
The above Additional Option may be incorporated in all the above 
Claim Forms as Column (c) of the Mode of Payments by way of affixing a 
Seal till the existing stocks are exhausted and to incorporate and get printed 
while printing new stocks of Forms. 
3.
Necessary Publicity may be made about the availability of the above 
facility for quick receipt of amount under Core Banking System through 
Circulars to All Regional Committee Members, Employers' and Employees' 
Federations, Notice Boards in the ROs and SROs, in the Visitors Hall, PRO's 
Room, Inspectorates, All Officers. and All Staff Members, Local Web Site of 
the RO or SRO etc. 
4.
Please acknowledge receipt. 
(This issues with the approval of F.A. & C.A.O.) 
(R. K. SINGH)
